notes: 7.0.1: models you already have no longer go online before loading — Qwen3-ASR used to check Hugging Face on every load and could hang for minutes on a slow network; every model now loads straight from disk. Model packs unzipped into the models folder count as installed (image-OCR models now live in models/rapidocr too). Missing models show live download progress (size and speed), and a failed download says why. / 7.0.1：已下载的模型加载时不再联网检查——以前 Qwen3-ASR 每次加载都要先连 Hugging Face，网络慢时会卡几分钟；现在所有模型都直接从本地加载。解压到 models 文件夹的模型包会被识别为已安装（图片 OCR 模型也改存到 models/rapidocr）。缺少模型时会实时显示下载进度（大小与速度），下载失败会显示原因。
